outcomes.name: before any Agent is set, an Agent key can't buy in (NotAgent)
the player's play key sets an Agent: this key, 1 hour, 0.016 SOL stake (no wallet prompt)
the Agent key reads its record: the wallet, the stake, nothing committed
the record is private: another logged-in key can't read it
a key that isn't the Agent can't buy in for the player (NotAgent)
buying in for more than the stake is refused (AgentStakeExceeded)
the Agent buys in 0.01 SOL from the player's game balance
...exactly 0.01 SOL left the game balance
its seat is the player's own seat (the wallet, not labelled), found by its table key
the record holds that seat and 0.01 SOL committed
a second seat while it holds one is refused (AgentBusy)
the player can't take a second seat at that table themselves (one seat per wallet)
a rebuy past the stake is refused (0.01 + 0.007 > 0.016)
a rebuy within it is fine (0.01 + 0.006)
a hand was played with the Agent's seat in it, and it acted with its table key
another seat's key can't cash out the Agent's seat (NotAgent)
the Agent cashes out its seat
...its whole stack went to the player's game balance
...and came off what it had committed; the seat is free
the player sits down themselves (play key)
the Agent can't rebuy into the player's own seat (AgentBusy)
the Agent can't cash out the player's own seat (NotAgentSeat)
the player leaves
the player sets the Agent again (the count starts anew)
the Agent sits down again
releasing a seat that's still there is refused (AgentBusy)
the player cashes the Agent's seat out with their play key
the record still holds the old seat: a new seat is refused (AgentBusy)
anyone frees it once the seat is gone (agent_release)
...without lowering what it had committed (0.01 SOL still counts)
the player stops the Agent
a stopped Agent can't buy in (NotAgent)
...nor read the record any more
a new Agent key for 20 s replaces the old one (one Agent per wallet)
the old key can't buy in (NotAgent)
after its time is up the Agent can't buy in (AgentExpired)
an Agent for longer than 7 days is refused
the player sets it for an hour
the player cancels their play keys (wallet, on Solana)
cancelling the play keys stops the Agent too (AgentExpired)
